title: verify_pisot.py: code for "Effective Bounds for Reciprocal Sums of Higher-Order Linear Recurrences"
description: Python script accompanying the paper "Effective Bounds for Reciprocal Sums of Higher-Order Linear Recurrences" by A. Suna and P. K. Ray. It reproduces the constants and thresholds in Tables 1-3: root isolation, certified bounds for the minimum modulus and contour averages of the characteristic polynomial on |z| = r (ball arithmetic via python-flint, with the double-precision steps and slack described in the paper), the thresholds N_0, the root-free bound under Perron's condition, and high-precision numerical checks of the nearest-integer identity. Requires Python 3.9+, python-flint, numpy, mpmath (see requirements.txt).
